newsitem.title: USA: Cirrus said lawsuit same as one in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Cirrus said lawsuit same as one in Feb.

text.p: Cirrus Logic Inc Tuesday, responding to news reports on Monday about a lawsuit filed recently against the company, said the action was the same lawsuit that was filed last February.
In a statement, Cirrus said the only new developments in the case have been favorable to the company.

On August 22, the company said the court dismissed half of the plaintiffs' case with prejudice including all of the plaintiffs' claims under the California securities laws and the plaintiffs' claims for breach of fiduciary duty.

On August 30, the company said the court stayed all proceedings pending its determination as to whether plaintiffs and their lawyers were adequate to represent a class. Neither plaintiffs nor their law firms have been appointed to represent a class in this lawsuit, the company said.
Cirrus Logic is a leading manufacturer of advanced integrated circuits for the desktop and portable computing, telecommunications, and consumer electronics markets.
